headline: The Commodities Feed: Oil nears $100/bbl amid Persian Gulf escalation

US2Y.source: US Treasury curve, inferred from 10Y 4.80% and 10Y-2Y spread 0.41%

learning_profile.note: No matching ACTIONABLE context-aware segment was used; matching oil-rising context signatures found were WATCH_ONLY/EARLY_SIGNAL and therefore advisory only.

predictions.mechanism: Escalating Persian Gulf supply risk and Brent near $100 increase geopolitical hedging demand for gold, though rising yields cap conviction.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid regional de-escalation, confirmation of no further tanker or infrastructure damage, and a sharp oil pullback.

predictions.mechanism: Europe is highly exposed to imported energy costs; near-$100 Brent raises inflation and margin pressure while yields are elevated.
predictions.invalidation: Brent falls materially below the recent breakout zone or geopolitical risk premium collapses.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil and renewed Persian Gulf escalation worsen the European inflation-growth mix and risk sentiment.
predictions.invalidation: Fast de-escalation and a material reversal lower in oil and bond yields.

predictions.mechanism: Higher energy costs and geopolitical risk are a modest drag on French equities despite sector diversification.
predictions.invalidation: Oil reverses sharply lower or the conflict de-escalates.

predictions.mechanism: Near-$100 Brent increases inflation and rate risk while fresh US strikes on Iranian tankers reinforce risk-off sentiment.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and Treasury yields fall sharply or the military situation de-escalates.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil feeds inflation expectations and elevated long yields pressure duration-sensitive technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp decline in US yields outweighs the geopolitical shock.

predictions.mechanism: Industrial and cyclical exposure is vulnerable to a renewed energy-price shock and broader risk-off move.
predictions.invalidation: Energy prices reverse and geopolitical escalation stops.

predictions.mechanism: Safe-haven demand supports silver but higher yields and growth concerns offset part of that impulse.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive risk-on move or a strong dollar/yield surge dominates precious-metal demand.
